title: Motif fill with the project's psc-motif-zigzag-3pt.pmf at 8 x 8 mm, Pattern1 only, and its motif line
description: A 40 x 40 mm square sewn as a motif fill with the project's 3-point motif at 8 x 8 mm, arrangement Pattern1 only, spacing and row offset 0, Direction 0, under sewing off, run pitch 5 mm: rows 8 mm apart, each motif's base line in the middle of its band, so the fill's stitches span 36 mm across the rows (the apexes 2 mm inside the outer bands' edges) and 40 mm along them; then the outline as the motif line of line-motif-zigzag-5x8. Replaces motif-fill-2pt, withdrawn with its capture (#1060). The capture holds Pattern2 too (the project's psc-motif-2pt.pmf, unused under Pattern1 only); arrangement Pattern1 and 2 is not sewn by OpenStitch yet (motif-fill-clean-p1p2 is kept as a formats fixture).
